data.title: Ethereum Price Analysis: Can ETH Hold $2,300 Support After a 12% Monthly Drop?
data.description: Buyers have stepped in to defend a key Ethereum price floor twice this month, but ETF outflows and a 12% monthly slide are testing their resolve. Whether that support holds or shatters could determine if ETH revisits levels not seen since summer.
